# SPACIA by Srijan Realty

SPACIA is a residential and retail development at Jessore Road South, Mouza Doharia, Ward 09, beside Reliance Mall, Madhyamgram, Kolkata 700129. It has 449 apartments across six G+12 towers on 3.6 acres, with 64% open space including podium, 3-side-open homes, an 18,000 sq.ft. clubhouse, and 29,000+ sq.ft. of retail. The currently published configurations are 3 BHK + 2T, 3 BHK + 3T and 4 BHK + 3T. Current official starting prices are ₹81.30 Lacs, ₹1.03 Cr and ₹1.19 Cr, respectively; confirm live prices and availability with Srijan Realty.

Srijan Realty advertises 2030 as the possession target. WBRERA records 31 December 2032 as the registered completion date. The WBRERA project detail page currently displays a quarterly status update default notice and “Not Started” status, while the district listing says “Under Construction”; confirm the current status and filings with Srijan Realty. Registration number: WBRERA/P/NOR/2025/003059.
